title: The leak scan passes a short real EC key body with a slash that a period, underscore or hyphen follows, because the path lookahead calls any run of short slash-separated pieces a repository path
goal: kbcommon.leak_hits flags the EC armor label before a single-line body of 20 to 40 base64 characters that holds a slash and that a period, an underscore or a hyphen follows, and still does not flag the label before a repository path

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import kbcommon
d = "-" * 5
arm = d + "BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY" + d
miss = [s for s in (".", "_x", "-x", ".pem") if not any(k == "secret" for k, _ in kbcommon.leak_hits(arm + " CwgQj8C/nbil1bW34cYU" + s))]
print("short slash-containing body not flagged before:", miss)
sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)
